english.note: Use this formal religious verb when guilt or sin is being removed or a person is made spiritually pure.

examples.english: We ask the Lord to purify us and remove our sins.
examples.traditional: 求主潔淨我哋，除去我哋嘅罪。
examples.jyutping: kau4 zyu2 git3 zing6 ngo5 dei6 ceoi4 heoi3 ngo5 dei6 ge3 zeoi6
